title: Content Creator Lead
description:
Want to be at the heart of one of the fastest-growing areas of e-commerce? Join a growing social commerce agency and take ownership of content strategy and delivery.

About the Company

Our client is a growing and forward-thinking organisation with a strong focus on digital engagement and brand growth. They are passionate about creating impactful online experiences and are looking for a creative, trend-driven professional to help elevate their social media presence. This is an exciting opportunity to join a collaborative team where innovation, creativity, and fresh ideas are encouraged.

About the Role

We are recruiting for a TikTok Content Creator Lead to take ownership of content strategy and delivery across one of the world's fastest-growing social media platforms. This role is ideal for an experienced content creator or social media specialist who understands what drives engagement and knows how to create content that resonates with audiences.

You will lead content planning, identify emerging trends, oversee content creation, and collaborate with wider marketing and communications teams to maximise brand awareness, reach, and engagement.

Benefits
- Salary of £32,000 - £40,000
- Opportunity to lead and shape creative social media strategy
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Career development and progression opportunities
- Work within a creative, fast-paced digital team
- Chance to make a significant impact on audience growth and engagement

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and execute TikTok content strategies aligned with business objectives and audience interests
- Lead, mentor, and inspire content creators to produce engaging, high-quality video content
- Collaborate with marketing, PR, and social media teams to ensure consistent messaging across campaigns
- Monitor trends, challenges, platform updates, and viral opportunities
- Manage and maintain content calendars, ensuring timely content delivery
- Analyse performance metrics and use insights to improve content performance
- Drive audience engagement through authentic community interaction
- Identify opportunities to increase brand awareness and follower growth

Essential Skills & Experience
- Proven experience managing TikTok or other short-form video social media platforms
- Strong understanding of TikTok trends, algorithms, and audience engagement
- Experience creating and delivering successful content campaigns
- Excellent communication and organisational skills
- Ability to analyse performance data and optimise content accordingly

Desirable Skills
- Experience leading or mentoring content creators
- Video editing and content production experience
- Experience working with influencers or brand partnerships
- Knowledge of wider social media and digital marketing channels

If you're passionate about creators, social commerce and TikTok, and you're looking for an opportunity where you can genuinely shape and grow a function, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Performance Marketing Manager

Warrington Hybrid Working 35,000- 40,000 + Bonus

A growing digital marketing agency is looking for an experienced Performance Marketing Manager to join their team and take ownership of paid media campaigns across Meta and Google Ads.

Working with a diverse client portfolio spanning financial services, events and consumer brands, you'll be responsible for driving performance, optimising campaigns and delivering measurable commercial results.

The Opportunity

This is a hands-on role where you'll manage campaigns from strategy through to execution, reporting and optimisation. You'll work closely with both clients and creative teams to identify opportunities for growth and maximise campaign performance.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and optimise paid campaigns across Meta and Google Ads
- Deliver strong performance against CPA, CPL and ROAS targets
- Analyse campaign data and implement ongoing improvements
- Collaborate with creative teams to develop high-performing ad creative
- Present campaign results and recommendations to clients
- Oversee tracking, attribution and conversion measurement
- Identify new opportunities to drive growth across client accounts

About You
- 3+ years' experience in Paid Social and/or PPC
- Strong knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads
- Experience using GA4 and conversion tracking tools
- Commercially focused with a data-driven mindset
- Confident communicating with clients and stakeholders
- Able to demonstrate successful campaign results

Desirable Experience
- Lead generation campaigns
- Financial services or regulated sectors
- Landing page optimisation and CRO
- TikTok Ads

What's on Offer?
- Salary of 35,000- 40,000 DOE
- Performance-related bonus
- Hybrid working
- Flexible working arrangements
- Generous holiday allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Pension scheme
- Clear progression path within a growing business
